title: Yeah Nah Pasaran #294 w Émile P. Torres on TESCREAL & the techno-fascist redux : July 23, 2026
content:
This week on Yeah Nah Pasaran! we talk to Dr. Émile P. Torres [Bluesky]. Émile is an author (most recently of the book Human Extinction: A History of the Science and Ethics of Annihilation), podcaster (Dystopia Now) and critic of the bundle of ideologies collectively known as TESCREAL: Transhumanism, Extropianism, Singularitarianism, Cosmism, Rationalism, Effective Altruism and Longtermism.

We first spoke to Émile about TESCREAL in October 2023. A few years later, we reviewed the situation in 2026 and discussed the rollout of AI (‘It must nestle everywhere, settle everywhere, establish connexions everywhere’!), AGI, ASI and the speculative fictions of Silicon Valley.

See also : Skeptical of the TESCREAL Acronym? Read This., Émile P. Torres, substack, July 10, 2026 /// The “Merge” With AI Has Already Begun, Émile P. title: Yeah Nah Pasaran #293 w Tom Tanuki on Q Australia : July 16, 2026
content:
This week on Yeah Nah Pasaran! we talk to RETVRN guest Tom Tanuki [Bluesky]. Tom was until recently a regular columnist for Independent Australia; he also has a Patreon account and YouTube channel. On this episode we spoke to Tom about Independent Australia and his decision to leave it, QAnon’s ongoing influence in Australia, and more.
